name: @oklch-picker/monorepo
description: Workspace root for oklch-picker. The published packages live in packages/.
author: Nick Bevers <hello@nickbevers.dev>

scripts.//build: Core first, explicitly. `--workspace=packages` runs them in alphabetical order, not dependency order, so `angular` built before `core` and `ngc` could not resolve `@oklch-picker/core`. It only ever passed locally because a previous build had left core's dist in place; a clean checkout failed, which is what CI does every time. Core is built twice now, which costs under a second and is worth not depending on the order npm happens to pick.
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@oklch-picker/core && npm run build --workspace=packages --if-present
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p packages/solid && tsc --noEmit -p packages/qwik && npm run build --workspace=@oklch-picker/angular && svelte-check --threshold error
scripts.examples:install: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/react install && npm --prefix examples/vue install && npm --prefix examples/svelte install && npm --prefix examples/solid install && npm --prefix examples/angular install && npm --prefix examples/qwik install && npm --prefix examples/astro install
scripts.examples:build: npm run build && npm --prefix examples/react run build && npm --prefix examples/vue run build && npm --prefix examples/svelte run build && npm --prefix examples/solid run build && npm --prefix examples/astro run build
scripts.site:dev: npm run build && npm run dev --workspace=@oklch-picker/site
scripts.site:build: npm run build && npm run build --workspace=@oklch-picker/site

//overrides: Qwik 1.20 caps its vite peer at <8 and this repo runs vite 8, which Astro 7 and the Svelte plugin both require. The optimizer runs fine on 8: it compiles the $() boundaries and the adapter's tests pass. The range is conservative metadata rather than a real incompatibility, so it is pinned to the repo's own vite instead of everyone passing --legacy-peer-deps. Revisit when Qwik 2 is stable; it accepts vite 8 but wants vitest <4 and this repo is on 4.
